teaching_order: Complete generic jet forcing, formation, transport and impact theory before laser/PFC source specialization.
chapter_arrangement: Substantial multi-concept chapters: assumptions, derivations, solved benchmarks, refinements, integrated calculations and formula-first reference answers. Arrangement follows earlier pressure-limit chapters.
theory_completion_scope: Governing/closure/initial/boundary data and solved analytical controls, with conservation and regime checks. Actual nonlinear target jets still require spatial solutions; no universal closed-form maximum is claimed.

architectures: Primary PFC-containing carrier layer below film/PVC
objectives: highest verified single-shot output under stated constraints
